//==
// # Sampled curves and surfaces
//
// Curves and surfaces recorded at discrete parameters rather than evaluated
// analytically: the discretized counterparts of the parametric forms, carrying
// their sample parameters so the original parameterization survives.

// A planar curve recorded at discrete parameters: Parameters and Points have
// equal length and Parameters ascend. Evaluation between samples
// interpolates linearly.
type SampledCurve2D
    implements IValue, IDeformable2D
{
    Parameters: Array<Number>;
    Points: Array<Point2D>;
}
